claim: Defines the per-step reward signal of the benchmark as the log wealth ratio between bankroll after and before matchday settlement.
Defines the expected logarithmic growth rate of capital W(b) for stake fractions b(x|y) under outcome distribution p(x,y) and gross odds o(x); the Kelly growth objective.
States that under the optimal proportional strategy with fair odds, the maximum growth rate equals the mutual information I(X;Y) between side information Y and outcome X.
Expresses expected log-growth in divergence form: the gain of betting beliefs p over market-implied distribution q relative to the true distribution p*, as a difference of KL divergences.
Gives the Kelly criterion stake fraction f* for a binary gamble with win probability p and net odds r.
Defines the per-matchday reward r_t as the change in log-bankroll, the dense verifiable reward signal of the KellyBench benchmark.
Defines the cumulative season reward R as the sum of per-matchday rewards, equal to the log-ratio of final to initial bankroll.
